{"basis":"measured","fact_type":"finding","name":"ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): closure_report cannot compute an owner's "design done" criterion, because its traceability leg is the DELIVERY predicate (satisfied + realized + a PASSING check). So a finished design with nothing built reads 0/7. Seams and decisions read null (nothing to run on), not closed. The budgets leg never reads `basis`, so "build done needs measured numbers" cannot be said either. The idea it was built from said "a design that closes can be built", and the build took "every leg a computation that already exists"","source":"art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29 (item I15, designer friction #31)","statement":"RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-09-29, item I15 of art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29.

① OBSERVED (friction #31 and the round-3 report on the ikg design, 0.74.0). With the criterion set to 100% on all five legs:
- traceability read 0/7;
- seams and decisions read "nothing to measure";
- budgets 16/16 and provenance 61/61 closed.
The owner had ruled: "'design done' may close a budget on an estimate marked as asserted. 'Build done' requires every budget to close on a measurement." Expected: the owner's criterion is computable. NOT affected: budgets and provenance, which read as the owner meant.

② PRECEDENT, searched in both designs: cap:closure-report, req:a-design-closes-against-a-declared-threshold-and-the-report-names-the-first-hole, dec:idea-a-design-closes-and-the-design-says-when (accepted), ver:a-design-closes-against-a-declared-threshold. None mentions a phase, or a design-versus-build reading.

③ CANDIDATES:
- (a) the criterion was set wrong;
- (b) the traceability leg is defined against the build;
- (c) the ikg design lacks the allocations and checks a design-phase reading would need;
- (d) seams and decisions are null for a modelling reason, not a closure reason;
- (e) the budgets leg ignores basis.

④⑤ MEASURED:
- closure.rs module doc: "TRACEABILITY — every live requirement traced to a capability with a passing check ([`DesignGraph::requirement_is_delivered`], the delivery line's own predicate)". closure.rs:437 calls requirement_is_delivered. So (b) holds.
- The ikg design's closure_report, read 2026-09-29, gives the leg's own reason: "has no capability that is built and currently checked". Its FIRST HOLE is req:anthony-provisions-what-the-engine-runs-on, the requirement the designer PARKED under the accepted delegation decision. So closure does not read parking either. That is a further sibling of the parks finding filed in this triage (fact:root-cause-parking-is-still-not-named-where-an-unsatisfied-requirement-is-read-2026-09-29).
- grep of closure.rs for basis, measured or estimated: none. The budgets leg reads BudgetVerdict only, so (e) holds.
- (c) was NOT measured requirement by requirement. The designer reports capabilities, allocations and planned checks for the engine's requirements. Whether each of the 7 has all three is unverified.
- Seams: "0 coupling(s) between parts, 23 contract pair(s) declared". No DEPENDS_ON between components was drawn, only contracts. That is (d), a finding about how seams are counted, not about phase, and is left with the designer's proposal to draw the ~20 real dependencies.
- dec:idea-a-design-closes-and-the-design-says-when's own words: "the requirements are all allocated and traced, every one has a verification that passes... A design that closes can be built". In the SE sense this is the pre-build verdict, where "passes" at design time means passes by analysis. The implementation took the only existing computation.

⑥ CLASS: a verdict defined for one lifecycle phase and reused for another, because only one phase had a computation to reuse. A fix at the class gives closure a declared PHASE, or each leg a declared basis: design-phase traceability means allocated and traced, with a planned check; build-phase means the delivery line; budgets close on estimates at design, on measurements at build. Fixing only the ikg design's criterion (candidate a) would not help the next owner who asks "is the design done?".

⑦⑧ OWED: a test that fails today (a fully allocated and traced design with planned checks and nothing built closes under a design-phase criterion and not under a build-phase one; a budget closing only on estimates closes at design and not at build; a parked requirement is reported as parked, not as the first hole), then the fix. The shape is open in dec:idea-closure-has-a-design-phase-reading-and-a-build-phase-reading.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED:
- Whether "a verification that passes" at design time should require an analysis-method check (the verification `method` field), or accept a planned check of any method. That is the owner's call.
- Whether a parked requirement should drop out of the traceability population or be counted separately, as detect_defects counts `swept.parked`.","steps":["closure_report","set_closure_criterion"],"subject_id":"cap:closure-report","valid_from":"2026-09-29","valid_to":"2026-09-29"}
